note: Causal claims require actual sealed independent training outcomes and matched protocols; negative results must be reported.

issues.answer: Random basis, isotropic and matched residual controls; report matched strength and realized output KL. If no difference, withdraw orientation necessity.

issues.answer: Three independent student lineages, common-eligible D4 and frozen HumanEval+, independently blinded algorithm family audit.
Clarify SPD reference-gradient ancestry, classical proximal operator, calibrated direction hypothesis and separate Learned extension.

issues.answer: Independent seed43-45 paired Plain/Fixed with across-run SD; trained second model family.
Anchor replay baseline and 40/50 fit comparison; disclose extra supervised tokens and non-equivalent compute.

issues.answer: Plain/Fixed/Plain+50-reference replay share a 7.2M causally shifted supervised target-token minimum per round with bounded whole-record overshoot. Report actual counts and separate synthesis/calibration/SFT/evaluation costs; this is not exact token equality or equal FLOPs.
Same-norm soft spectrum, random basis and isotropic scale, and residual matched-blend; output KL not guaranteed equal.

issues.answer: Report pass1/pass64/C64/frontier plus negative APPS and paired D4 with denominators.

issues.answer: Separate frozen decoder evaluation from synthesis-only training; independent temperature and top-p controls plus bundled SSD recipe. c29 and repository c30 share a recipe and are not independent algorithmic baselines.

issues.answer: Use the weight-interpolation alternative: full-weight native alpha0.5/0.75 for both Plain and Fixed. This does not implement a training-time KL-to-initial baseline; check original wording if both were requested.
